audit.why: Leona holds a hard-CC advantage through level 5 (E-Q chain vs Karma's Q slow), evens at 6 when Mantra doubles as a real tool, and narrows further with Karma's peel items — matches the existing phase chart.

Leona's spikes are level 2 (E-Q online), level 6 (Solar Flare adds a second hard CC vs Karma's non-CC Mantra empower), and first item (tankiness eats her poke). Karma's counter-spike is a second item that funds Mantra-E shield/speed peel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields call Karma's Inner Flame (Q) a 'snare' and attribute a speed boost to 'RW' (Focused Resolve, her W). Per the kit, Q's flag is slow (not snare), and the only Move Speed grant is on E (Inspire), which is what Mantra (R) empowers for the disengage combo (RE), not RW.
audit.why: W (Focused Resolve) is a targeted tether/root — no self-speed component. Speed and shield both live on E (Inspire); the Mantra bonus on E extends the shield and applies Inspire's speed. Calling this 'RW speed' misidentifies which ability enables her disengage, which matters for tracking her cooldowns to time an all-in.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'snare' with 'slow' for Q, and 'RW speed' with 'Mantra-E (RE) speed' across the affected fields.
sources: brief enemyKit (Q flags: slow; E text: Move Speed to protected ally; W text: tether/root, no speed)
